stories.title: 25 years after 9/11, Strahan, Testaverde, others relive the emotional memories
stories.summary: Hall of Famers, franchise greats and more recount the moments they experienced in the aftermath of the attacks.

stories.title: Falcons' Tagovailoa out, Rush to start vs. Steelers
stories.summary: The Falcons will start backup Cooper Rush at quarterback in Sunday's opener against the Steelers after ruling starter Tua Tagovailoa out with an oblique injury.

stories.title: 'Gonna let them do them': Cunningham ignoring Kanter Freedom, White
stories.summary: Sophie Cunningham says she is focusing on the Fever's remaining games and not the commotion around Enes Kanter Freedom and Royce White declaring for the WNBA draft.

stories.title: Pulisic 'upset' about Milan bench role, coach Amorim says
stories.summary: Christian Pulisic is "upset" about not yet featuring for Milan this season, coach Ruben Amorim said Friday before hinting that the United States star is likely to get some playing time this weekend.

stories.title: Sources: 49ers reward Shanahan with multiyear extension
stories.summary: The 49ers have given a multiyear extension to head coach Kyle Shanahan, sources confirmed to ESPN. He has an 83-67 record in his 10 seasons.
